beats.label: 冒頭フック（タイトル）
beats.description: Cold open. The creator is seated in his gaming chair holding a controller, mid-eFootball play, talking/reacting to the game. The usable framing is settled and fairly tight: his face AND the controller are both in frame. A multi-line title card is burned in over him, always starting with 'ウイイレ日本2位'. IMPORTANT: the raw footage almost always opens with several seconds of the camera being placed and framed — handheld wobble, his back, a half-empty chair, him leaning in and out of frame. That is never the hook; the hook starts after the framing settles and he is actually playing.
captionExamples:
ウイイレ日本2位
プロゲーマーの日常

ウイイレ日本2位
インドネシア渡航まで2日
プロゲーマーの日常

ウイイレ日本2位
メンテナンス日の
プロゲーマーの日常

ウイイレ日本2位
負けず嫌いな
プロゲーマーの日常

ウイイレ日本2位
世界大会予選の
プロゲーマーの日常

exemplars.rule: 落ち着いた画角で顔とコントローラーが両方フレームに入り、プレイしながら喋る/リアクションしている瞬間だけを使う。ファイル冒頭のカメラを置いて画角を合わせている数秒（手ブレ・背中・見切れ）は絶対に使わない。
exemplars.sourceNote: タイトルなし.mp4 の 6.43s〜9.33s を本人が手でトリムしたもの

beats.label: 起床・朝の挨拶
beats.description: Morning wake-up, filmed wide from across the room: bed, window and curtains in frame. He sits UP on the bed, turns to face the camera, and delivers the morning line ('おはようございます!今日も一日、元気にいきましょう!'), closing on a reaction to camera — usually a thumbs-up. The beat is that whole little arc: sitting up → facing camera → the closing gesture. Shots of him with his back to camera, making the bed, tidying, or walking around the bedroom are NOT this beat and are not used at all.
captionExamples:
今日も
GENKIにいきましょー!

8:01
勝ち上がると
Regional Final

exemplars.rule: ベッドに起き上がってカメラを正面に見る所から、サムズアップ等のリアクションで締まる所まで、ひとまとまりで使う。布団を整える・部屋を歩き回る・背中を向けているカットは起床ビートではない。
exemplars.sourceNote: タイトルなし.mp4 の 65.30s〜69.60s を本人が手でトリムしたもの

beats.label: 朝食（完全栄養食シェイク）
beats.description: Rapid quick-cut sequence: holds a product bag up to his face (usually uFit完全栄養食), does a little 'シャカシャカダンス' shaking the shaker, then drinks ('ゴクゴクっ') and gives a thumbs-up 'おいしー!'. In one episode this is an oatmeal bowl instead (オートミール/チアシード/ハチミツ/ブルーベリー). Standing/seated against a plain wall.

シャカシャカ
ダンス

8:30

（ほうじ茶味）

beats.label: eFootball練習
beats.description: The long daily eFootball practice session: he sits at his desk or in his chair with a controller, playing, often with a smart-speaker clock visible. This beat is a TIMELAPSE — in the finished edit it is a couple of seconds of heavily sped-up footage, not a real-time slice, because the point is that it went on for an hour. So pick a LONG continuous stretch of him actually playing (tens of seconds), not a short representative moment, and caption it with the time RANGE it covered (e.g. '10:30〜11:30') rather than a single instant.
captionExamples:
10:00〜13:00
大会に向けて
eFootballトレーニング

beats.label: 日中の外出・活動
beats.description: The day's variable main activity, usually out of the house: walking (POV of feet/streets), station/townscape B-roll, a sponsor or business meeting, a cafe meeting, meeting viewers, or a haircut. Time-of-day captions in the 11:00–18:00 range with a short label of the activity.

exemplars.rule: 外出先は「被写体そのものの寄り（コーヒーカップ・商品）」と「人が入った画（友達とのセルフィー）」を2〜3秒ずつ短く畳みかける。移動中や何も起きていない画は使わない。
exemplars.sourceNote: タイトルなし.mp4 の 160.10-162.67 と 164.23-167.27 を本人が手でトリム・連結したもの

exemplars.rule: 商品お披露目は、商品名がはっきり読めるように掲げ切った所だけを1〜1.5秒で使う。持ち上げる前の喋りや溜めは一切入れない。
exemplars.sourceNote: タイトルなし.mp4 の 211.30-212.53 を本人が手でトリムしたもの

beats.label: 食事（昼〜夕）
beats.description: A meal. The cut that is actually used is him EATING — chopsticks going to his mouth, a mouthful, slurping noodles — usually ending on the reaction ('おいしー!' / a thumbs-up). The lead-in where he is holding the bowl and TALKING about the food, before anything is eaten, is not this beat: if a shot contains both, start the cut at the first bite, not at the talking. A close-up of the food itself can precede it as its own quick cut.
captionExamples:
13:10
お寿司
いただきます

beats.label: 夜食（麺類）
beats.description: Night meal: overhead shot of noodles boiling in a pot, then a slurping/eating reaction to camera. Usually soba or udon with 'いただきます!/フーフー/おいしい!'.
